markdown:
## 防御延续，硬件失速

截至 10 月 23 日这一观察窗口，美股综合市场状态仍为防御。可用的最新 Regime Risk Score 为 65.7，实际观察日期为 10 月 21 日，并非完整的 10 月 23 日重算结果。部分来源仍待更新；本期优先解释风险结构，而非分数的短期变化。

市场风险 62.8、参与度风险 56.5、金融压力 51.8 均处谨慎区间，脆弱性为 92.0。压力并非集中在某一个价格指标，而是体现为较弱的参与面、较高的结构脆弱性与行业领导趋势受损。

半导体与 AI 硬件综合分数降至 0 / Weak，SMH 近 20 个交易日下跌 13.1%。周频风险模型继续给出 Level 5 / 35% 参考风险敞口。本期判断维持防御，等待广度与行业动量共同修复，而不是因局部反弹提前扩大风险。

## 模型修订之后，先看风险结构

本周 HML 数据覆盖规则进行了调整，UMD 继续使用保留的代理方法。当前综合状态属于估算输入版本；HML 使用覆盖达标日期的估算，并非完整形成期或时点数据认证。新旧评分不具备严格可比性，不能将 65.7 与上期 58.1 的差额全部解释为市场恶化。

本期显示的四支柱中，脆弱性显著高于其余三项。92.0 是模型标准化风险分数，不是下跌概率。金融压力 51.8 也应与独立金融条件数据及其观察日期一并阅读，不能仅凭状态标签推断系统性危机。

模型权重与周度风控仓位规则并未因本次来源规则调整而改变。缺失因子日期不前填，来源未就绪的部分保持待更新。只有在口径一致、覆盖完整的序列中，才适合评估风险分数的变化。

## 广度与因子：拥挤不能混同估值

首页显示的市场宽度约为 40.0%，对应 9 月末的官方月度观察，而非 10 月 23 日当日的广度测量。页面另列来源与 nowcast 日期；这些更新日期不能替代官方观察期。本期保留月度标签，不把不同频率、定义的广度连成一条趋势。

因子拥挤度模块显示，多空版本为 0.758 / L3，beta 调整多头版本为 0.872 / L4，观察期为 8 月末。这些仍是偏高集中与共同调整风险的线索，但不应称为本周新发生的拥挤跃升。

估值层显示 HML 约第 96 百分位，界面含义为价值相对更便宜，并不是“96% 拥挤度”；UMD 显示约第 28 百分位，方向与 HML 不同。NFCI−ANFCI 为 0.022，实际数据截至 10 月 16 日。以上指标均应保留各自定义与时滞，不能拼接为同步的风险确认。

## AI 硬件：低分不等于低风险

截至 10 月 23 日，AI 硬件综合状态为 0 / Weak，原始分数约 -3.8，被限制在展示区间下界 0。这表示趋势支撑弱，不代表风险为零；其分数方向与综合市场风险模型相反。

需求动量与供应链确认均显示为 0，领导力宽度约 7，相对风险偏好约 16。多个支柱同时失去支撑，使得仅依赖少数股票反弹来判断行业恢复的证据不足。

28 只监测股票中，约 7% 站上 20 日均线，约 11% 站上 50 日均线。这里是短中期均线参与，不是 200 日均线。行业热度约 34，而分化脆弱性约 77；价格降温与较高的内部不均衡可以同时存在。

## 行业内部：回撤与相对落后并存

SMH 近 20 个交易日下跌 13.1%，相对 QQQ 落后约 7.7 个百分点。行业不仅出现绝对回撤，也失去了相对表现优势。该数据是看板调整价格窗口变化，不应自动当作独立重建的含息总回报。

同一监测样本中，TXN、ADI、NXPI 的近 20 日变化分别约 +2.4%、-0.6%、-1.3%；较弱的 ARM、STX、INTC 分别约 -32.2%、-31.2%、-29.3%。排名靠前并不等于普遍上涨，也不意味着整个行业具备可持续领导力。

后续修复应从参与扩散开始验证：更多股票重回均线上方，需求与供应链确认离开低位，相对大盘的趋势趋稳。分化脆弱性仍高时，个别反弹不足以证明全面修复。固定 28 股样本的结论也不能直接外推为整个科技板块。

## 利率：净变化小，内部力量在抵消

ACM 数据截至 10 月 22 日。10 年期拟合收益率为 4.926%，由预期平均短端利率分项 4.287% 与期限溢价 0.639% 构成。这是模型拟合与分解，不是当日国债实际成交收益率。

在 9 月 22 日至 10 月 22 日窗口，拟合收益率仅上升 0.67 bp：预期分项贡献 -6.03 bp，期限溢价贡献 +6.70 bp。两股力量基本抵消，因此不能把净变化很小理解为两个分项都没有变化，也不宜用接近零的净变化计算贡献占比。

三个月、六个月及一年累计变化分别为 +19.14、+58.56、+91.01 bp，较长窗口仍主要由预期分项推动。当前利率端的边际平稳，不能单独抵消股票市场的弱广度、行业趋势破坏与高脆弱性。

## 策略观察：等待共同修复

周频风险模型在 10 月 23 日显示 Level 5 / 35%，首页状态为 PARTIAL / FRESH。35% 是模型参考风险敞口，不是作者或任何账户的实际持仓。本报告不将部分输入状态改写成所有数据均已完备。

防御判断的主要依据是脆弱性高、参与不足与半导体 / AI 硬件失去趋势支撑。避免把零分理解为机械抄底信号，也避免因综合状态仍在防御区间就推断必然发生急跌。模型用于组织证据，不替代判断。

下期重点依次为：估算输入与覆盖状态是否完成更新；全市场参与是否改善；AI 硬件均线广度、需求与供应链是否同步修复；信用与利率是否出现新的压力。Livermore S2 的 49.0 / Normal 是独立趋势线索，不是系统性流动性安全证明。

## 数据口径、来源与披露

本期编号 RI-WR-2026-W43，主要观察截止日为 2026-10-23，制作及发布日期为 2026-10-24。报告依据作者提供的周评及四张看板截图冻结读数，未重算模型。综合状态截至 10-21；ACM 截至 10-22；周频风险与 AI 硬件截至 10-23；金融条件截至 10-16；月度广度及因子拥挤度另有滞后。

综合风险分数越高表示风险越高：低于 35 为建设性，35 至低于 50 为中性，50 至低于 65 为谨慎，65 至低于 80 为防御，80 及以上为压力。AI 支撑型支柱高分表示支撑较强，热度与分化高分则表示风险较高。缺失值不替换成零。

图表使用截图可核实的显示精度，不制造历史路径。百分比与百分点分开表述；1 bp 为 0.01 个百分点。不同窗口和分项可能存在四舍五入差异。HML 96% 为估值分位，AI 7% 为 20DMA 广度。未使用未来日期 WQS 卡片作为当期已实现数据；山景仅为品牌视觉。

本材料由 Residual Inertia | 余势制作，作者 Taiyang Feng (Sunny)，仅用于独立研究与信息交流，不构成投资或证券交易建议。模型参考敞口不代表实际持仓；历史表现与模型状态不保证未来结果。

## 参考数据

[本期冻结观察数据](https://residualinertia.com/assets/papers/ri-weekly-2026-10-24-data.json)

markdown_en:
## Defense persists; hardware loses momentum

For the observation window ending October 23, the U.S. equity composite remains Defensive. The latest available Regime Risk Score is 65.7, observed on October 21; it is not a complete October 23 recalculation. Some sources remain pending. This edition focuses on risk structure rather than short-term score changes.

Market Risk at 62.8, Participation risk at 56.5 and Financial Stress at 51.8 are all in Caution, while Fragility stands at 92.0. The concern extends beyond a single price indicator: weak participation, elevated structural fragility and damaged sector leadership coexist.

The semiconductor and AI hardware composite has fallen to 0 / Weak, and SMH lost 13.1% over 20 trading sessions. The weekly risk model remains at Level 5 with 35% reference risk exposure. The research stance stays defensive, awaiting joint improvement in breadth and industry momentum before taking more risk.

## After the revision, read the risk structure

HML data-coverage rules changed this week, while the retained UMD proxy methodology continues. The current composite uses estimated inputs: HML estimates are restricted to dates passing coverage gates, rather than a fully certified formation-period or point-in-time dataset. The new and old scores are not strictly comparable; the difference between 65.7 and last edition's 58.1 cannot all be attributed to market deterioration.

Fragility is substantially higher than the other three pillars. Its 92.0 reading is a standardized model risk score, not a probability of a decline. Financial Stress at 51.8 should also be read alongside independently dated financial-conditions observations; a state label alone does not establish a systemic crisis.

Model weights and the weekly exposure rules were not changed by this source-rule revision. Missing factor dates are not forward-filled, and unavailable inputs remain pending. Score changes should be assessed only within a consistent methodology and adequately covered series.

## Breadth and factors: crowding is not valuation

The home dashboard shows approximately 40.0% market breadth for the official end-September monthly observation, not an October 23 daily measurement. Separate source and nowcast dates do not replace that official period. This report retains the monthly label and does not join differently defined or differently sampled breadth measures into one trend.

The factor-crowding module shows 0.758 / L3 for the long-short specification and 0.872 / L4 for the beta-adjusted long-only specification, both observed at end-August. These remain signals of concentration and common-unwind risk, but they should not be described as a new jump in crowding this week.

The valuation layer places HML around its 96th percentile, which the dashboard interprets as relatively cheaper value, not “96% crowding.” UMD is around its 28th percentile and has a different direction. NFCI minus ANFCI is 0.022, observed October 16. Definitions and lags must be preserved rather than treating all readings as simultaneous risk confirmation.

## AI hardware: a low score is not low risk

As of October 23, AI hardware is at 0 / Weak. Its raw score of approximately -3.8 is clipped to the display floor of zero. This means weak trend support, not zero risk; the score direction is opposite to that of the broad market risk model.

Demand momentum and supply-chain confirmation both display zero, with leadership breadth around 7 and relative risk appetite around 16. Weakness across several pillars provides little basis for declaring a sector recovery solely from rebounds in a few stocks.

Among 28 monitored stocks, roughly 7% are above their 20-day moving average and 11% above their 50-day average. These are short- and medium-term participation measures, not 200-day breadth. Sector heat is around 34 while divergence fragility is around 77: cooling prices and elevated internal dispersion can coexist.

## Sector internals: absolute and relative weakness

SMH declined 13.1% over 20 trading sessions and underperformed QQQ by about 7.7 percentage points. The sector has suffered both an absolute drawdown and relative weakness. These are dashboard adjusted-price window changes, not an independently reconstructed total-return series.
